correctness.rationale: Kummer carry argument proves valuation 1 impossible; shifted runs of binary ones give each valuation >=2. Exact doubling odd-factorial and separated-block factorial ratio prove limit existence and multiplicativity. The seeds are 7 and 5 modulo eight, giving all units; products with valuation seeds and dyadic stabilization yield every other class infinitely often. Standalone checker tested exact small cases, block identities, generators and spectra.
